subject: Vantage Financial — IR playbook, log extracts, and postmortem packet
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@vantagefinancial.com>
To: logan_wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vantagefinancial.com; Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@vantagefinancial.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: IR playbook + March incident artifacts for SOC 2 review

Hi Logan,

Vantage is running a SOC 2 readiness window and procurement has requested incident response artifacts for vendor risk assessment. Specifically we need:

- Company IR playbook (latest)
- Redacted postmortem for any security incidents in the last 12 months (we flagged a March 2028 auth anomaly)
- Log extracts and retention policy details for API access logs covering 2028-03-01 through 2028-04-30

Can you confirm what you can provide and the expected timeline? We're aiming to complete evidence collection by 2028-06-30. If there are approvals required, please point me to the right contact.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Vendor Risk Lead — Vantage Financial
Elena.Martinez@vantagefinancial.com

[Attachment: Vantage_Request_Form.pdf (pdf)]

From: logan_wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@vantagefinancial.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>; karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR playbook + March incident artifacts for SOC 2 review

Elena — thanks for the clear list.

Quick notes:
- We can share a redacted copy of our current incident response playbook and the postmortem for the March auth anomaly.
- Log extracts are available but we'll need to coordinate scoping (which tenants, which fields) and we will sanitize any PII per our contract.
- I’m looping in Marissa (security) and Karthik (SRE/compliance) to prepare the package and estimate turnaround.

Target: initial packet by 2028-06-21; final delivery by 2028-06-27 after internal review. Does that work for your timeline?

—Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0139

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@vantagefinancial.com>; logan_wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: IR playbook + March incident artifacts for SOC 2 review

Hi Elena — looping in the security artifacts you requested. Summary below and attachments are shared to a secure link.

What we're sending (initial delivery):
- RI_IR_Playbook_v1.3.pdf — redacted for internal phone numbers and unrelated internal ticket IDs.
- postmortem-2028-03-12-redacted.pdf — redacted for customer identifiers and non-relevant telemetry.
- vantage_log_extracts_202803-202804.zip — scored and filtered extracts (fields: timestamp, request_id, client_id, endpoint, response_code, latency_ms). Sensitive fields removed.

Notes and caveats:
- Log scope: API traffic for Vantage tenant IDs VGT-001, VGT-002 only. If you need broader tenant coverage we need an approved data export request form.
- Retention policy: API request logs stored 90 days by default; we can provide retention policy doc (attached) and a signed statement of deletion for any ad-hoc extracts.
- For SOC 2 evidence chain-of-custody: we provide MD5 checksums for each export and an access log showing who downloaded artifacts.

Attachments: RI_IR_Playbook_v1.3.pdf (pdf), postmortem-2028-03-12-redacted.pdf (pdf), vantage_log_extracts_202803-202804.zip (csvs inside).

If Vantage needs a walkthrough, I can schedule a 30–45 minute call to go through redaction decisions and the log schema. Proposed slots: 2028-06-21 09:00–11:00 PT or 2028-06-21 14:00–16:00 PT.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

[Secure link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/IR/RI_IR_Playbook_v1.3]

From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@vantagefinancial.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>; Elena Martinez <elena@vantagefinancial.com>
Cc: logan_wright <logan@redwood.com>; procurement@vantagefinancial.com
Date: 2028-06-20T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR playbook + March incident artifacts for SOC 2 review

Marissa — thanks for the prompt delivery. Two quick requests from our side after a short review:

1) Can you confirm the exact redaction rules applied to the postmortem (we need to see that customer-specific identifiers were removed but that timelines and root cause analysis remain intact)?
2) The log extracts include client_id values but we need a mapping statement that shows which client_id corresponds to which Vantage tenant (VGT-001, VGT-002). If that mapping is sensitive, we accept a redacted attestation signed by Redwood.

Also, we prefer the walkthrough tomorrow (2028-06-21) at 10:30 PT if that slot is still open.

Thanks — Tom
Vendor Risk — Vantage Financial

Cc: logan_wright <logan@redwood.com>; karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: IR playbook + March incident artifacts for SOC 2 review

Tom — quick answers and next steps: 

1) Redaction rules: customer identifiers (emails, account numbers) removed; internal ticket IDs replaced with hashed placeholders; timeline, root cause, remediation actions and evidence references left intact. I attached a short redaction log (redaction-log.txt) to the shared folder.

2) Client_id mapping: We cannot share direct PII mappings in a CSV due to our contract, but we will provide a signed attestation mapping VGT-001 and VGT-002 to the extracts and a private mapping delivered via a secure short-lived vault link on request. Attached: "mapping-attestation-signed.pdf" (signed, non-PII).

3) Call: 2028-06-21 10:30 PT is booked — invite sent to all. We'll run through the postmortem redactions and the log schema. Expect a final packet (with checksums and access log) by 2028-06-27 after your internal review and our legal sign-off.

If you need anything else before the walkthrough, ping me directly.

—Marissa
Senior Security Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

[Attachments available in secure folder: RI_IR_Playbook_v1.3.pdf, postmortem-2028-03-12-redacted.pdf, vantage_log_extracts_202803-202804.zip, redaction-log.txt, mapping-attestation-signed.pdf]
